notes: NCore 11.7.123: NCore moved to new, faster servers that no longer go to sleep — no more outages from the backend pausing. Sign in with your username or your email, or use "Continue with Google" on the website. Group chats now hold up to 50 people. The marketplace has been removed so NCore can focus on chat, voice, video and screen sharing. Added Privacy Policy and Terms of Service pages. Password reset and confirmation emails now link to NCore instead of a broken local address, and are sent from no-reply@nyptid.com. Because of the server move, you will need to sign in once more. Your account, password, messages and friends all came with you.
